instruction: A clean studio photograph in a medium shot captures two men against a solid pink backdrop. On the left, the bald Black man in the dusty rose t-shirt (R1) stands in profile facing right, leaning forward. On the right, the East Asian man in the yellow t-shirt (R2) stands in profile facing left. They lock eyes intensely while clasping their right hands together in a firm, upright handshake grip with bent elbows, creating a tense, competitive stance. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting that highlights their profiles and the warm color palette of their clothing against the pink background.
elements: R1 leans forward in profile while clasping R2's right hand in a tense handshake
R2 faces R1 in profile while reciprocally clasping R1's right hand

solid pink studio backdrop with soft even lighting
